Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to gather the required historical weather data. Instead of extracting the specific number of rainy days (with at least 0.5mm precipitation) for the first week of September from 2020 to 2023, it only performed a search and provided a screenshot of the Bing search results page. It did not click on any links to view the detailed data (e.g., from Weatherspark) nor did it extract the necessary figures to calculate the probability. Consequently, no data was available for the Assistant to process, leading to the hallucinated final answer of "20".
